biblStruct.note: In Appendix I the following excerpts (text only) are given from the anonymous reworking of Yefet b. Eli’s Judaeo-Arabic translation of Isaiah contained in Ms. Hunt. 206 of the Bodleian Library: ad 3:16–26; 8:16–9:1, 5–6; 11:3, 11; 21:1–10; 34:11–15; 38:9–22; 52:13–53:12. On the later identification of this Ms. with Yefet’s work see, inter alios, P. Birnbaum’s 1942 edition of Yefet on Hosea https://biblia-arabica.com/bibl/34RLRYC5 and E. Schlossberg’s 2000 Pe‘amim article https://biblia-arabica.com/bibl/NY3EPQ72. (Biblia Arabica)
